response.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: High-rate means feerate strictly greater than 0.0009 (the cutoff itself is excluded).
recordvault is treated as unique per order, so each fee matches at most one order. The inner join drops fees with no matching order.

alternatives.interpretation: High-rate includes the cutoff, so feerate >= 0.0009.
